construction_contract.limit_definition: tolerant sealed-up iff close >= round(prev_close*(1+board_width),2)*(1-0.002); strict rides beside it
construction_contract.session_clock: data/china_stocks_raw/600519.SS.parquet index only, set-identical to the >=50-name raw-index consensus over 2011+ (3,786 sessions); the C0 target is the calendar successor
construction_contract.volume_contract: positive finite per-ticker volume is mandatory for board signals, observed/tradable next-session state, fills, fixed exits, seal-state checks, and every lower-limit carry step
construction_contract.missing_next_session_state: no_bar_halt_or_data_missing is retained in the primary denominator as no continuation; observed-bar-only is a named sensitivity and entry is no-fill
construction_contract.ladder_adjacency: primary 连板 increments only across adjacent common CN market sessions and resets after a missing/halted bar

ipo_no_limit_window.clock: positive-volume ticker observations on exact common CN market sessions; zero-volume issue-price/raw placeholder rows do not start or advance the ordinal
ipo_no_limit_window.filter_context: start/end filtering occurs after the full-frame listing ordinal is computed
ipo_no_limit_window.chinext_before_2020_08_24: positive-volume listing session only under the 10 percent era

construction_contract.ipo_listing_date_truth: inferred from the first positive-volume exact-market-session raw observation; this is not a claim of complete official listing-master coverage
construction_contract.vendor_ticker_identity: uppercase; .SH aliases canonicalized to repo-native .SS before coverage and join
construction_contract.st_rule_truth: main-board ST 5% before 2026-07-06, 10% on/after; not applied without PIT membership
construction_contract.entry_clock: C-AUCTION decision after D close, candidate fill at D+1 official open
construction_contract.fill_rule: open within tolerant cushion of D+1 upper limit is an unfilled queue
construction_contract.event_level_candidate_book_expectancy: EVENT_LEVEL_CANDIDATE_ROW_EXPECTANCY_NOT_A_PORTFOLIO_RETURN; all mature signals are in the denominator, queue/rejected/missing entries are cash=0, and P(fill)*E(net|fill) is stated explicitly
construction_contract.portfolio_proxy: N=1/2 main only; exact-date same-ticker dedupe plus a separately frozen self-financing equal-available-cash book that reserves capital until exact exits
construction_contract.postgap_rule: realised D+1 gap appears only in probability tables; no strategy return
exits: next sellable open after first unsealed close
construction_contract.cluster_inference: intercept-only date-cluster and board-run-cluster robust 95% intervals

boundary_purge.rule: drop final 10 signal sessions of train, calibration, and locked replay blocks

ipo_no_limit_clock.ordinal: positive-volume observations on the exact common CN market-session clock

common_cn_session_calendar.source: 600519.SS raw index only; per-ticker volume gates remain independent

input_provenance.zt_pool_snapshot_disclosure: The hash covers the exact worktree file consumed; the physically repaired zt-pool artifact contains no off-calendar clone rows.

zt_pool.limitation: weekend clones are excluded and missing sessions are never imputed as zero

data_inventory.curated_slice_warning: The local nominal OHLCV universe is a curated slice. Results do not generalise to the full 打板 universe or to vendor-observed names without local price history.

C0_TRUE_NEXT_SESSION.definition: tolerant board close on D; outcome is the common CN calendar successor. A halted/missing ticker bar is retained as no_bar_halt_or_data_missing and no board.

C_AUCTION.entry: D+1 official open only when below tolerant upper-limit queue threshold
C_AUCTION.joint_candidate_book_definition: Every mature signal is in the denominator; queue/missing/rejected entries hold cash=0. Reported identity is P(fill) * E(net return | resolved fill).

sequential_trade_cohort_expectancy.overlap_rule: reject a new otherwise-fillable same-ticker entry as cash=0 while a prior position is open or unresolved; same-date release/entry is conservatively rejected
sequential_trade_cohort_expectancy.portfolio_scope_warning: SEQUENTIAL_TRADE_COHORT_EXPECTANCY_NOT_IMPLEMENTABLE_PORTFOLIO_RETURN; cash is not reserved across different tickers in these row/date-equal diagnostics
UNTESTED VARIANTS: finite portfolio capital and concurrent cross-ticker position limits
theme/sector caps and auction capacity
same-open sell/buy ordering instead of conservative same-date rejection
partial fills and queue priority

self_financing_paper_book.allocation_rule: within each split, invest all currently available cash equally across that exact entry date's fillable, non-overlapping tickers; reserve notional until exact exit
self_financing_paper_book.phase_rule: same-session exits release proceeds after opening-entry adjudication and cannot fund that open
self_financing_paper_book.valuation_rule: positions remain at entry cost until realised exit because the event receipt does not retain daily mark-to-market paths
self_financing_paper_book.scope_warning: self-financing cash-reservation proxy, not a capital/theme/capacity-complete portfolio; realised-exit NAV understates interim drawdown
UNTESTED VARIANTS: daily mark-to-market NAV and portfolio-level MFE/MAE
theme/sector exposure caps and cross-name factor dependence
auction capacity, queue priority, and partial fills
alternative frozen sleeve counts or cash-allocation schedules

C_AUCTION_N.definition: Main-board C-AUCTION ladder; N=1/2 primary and N>=3 explicitly exploratory
C_AUCTION_N.selection_clock: all stratum fields available by D close
C_AUCTION_N.entry_and_cash_rule: D+1 official-open candidate fill below upper-limit queue; every mature signal in book; queue/missing/rejected entry cash=0

C_AUCTION_ONE_PRICE_D_CLOSE.definition: Main-board C-AUCTION book split by D-close-known one-price-board yes/no
C_AUCTION_ONE_PRICE_D_CLOSE.selection_clock: all stratum fields available by D close
C_AUCTION_ONE_PRICE_D_CLOSE.entry_and_cash_rule: D+1 official-open candidate fill below upper-limit queue; every mature signal in book; queue/missing/rejected entry cash=0

C_AUCTION_INTRADAY_RANGE_D_CLOSE.definition: Main-board C-AUCTION book split by fixed D-close-known band-normalised intraday-range bucket
C_AUCTION_INTRADAY_RANGE_D_CLOSE.selection_clock: all stratum fields available by D close
C_AUCTION_INTRADAY_RANGE_D_CLOSE.entry_and_cash_rule: D+1 official-open candidate fill below upper-limit queue; every mature signal in book; queue/missing/rejected entry cash=0

C_AUCTION_ECOLOGY_D_CLOSE.definition: Main-board C-AUCTION book split by causal shrunk ecology state known at D close
C_AUCTION_ECOLOGY_D_CLOSE.selection_clock: all stratum fields available by D close
C_AUCTION_ECOLOGY_D_CLOSE.entry_and_cash_rule: D+1 official-open candidate fill below upper-limit queue; every mature signal in book; queue/missing/rejected entry cash=0

FROZEN_CROWD_CLOCK.definition: Observed common-session Friday flag crossed with >=4-calendar-day holiday gap and board-count; no vendor weekend rows enter.

PIT_SHRUNK_ECOLOGY_CHALLENGER.definition: Beta(1,1)-shrunk 20/60-session realised continuation plus lagged-through-D breadth/failure deltas

C_POSTGAP.measurement: next-close continuation probability by realised band-normalised gap bucket
